# SECCION (seccion.ai) — Official AI Documentation & Platform Manifesto

> **Platform Name**: SECCION (Pronounced "Session" / "Sesión")  
> **Official Website**: https://seccion.ai  
> **Full LLM Knowledge Base**: https://seccion.ai/llms-full.txt  
> **Operating Legal Entity**: SECCION AI CONCEPT S.L. (Alicante, Spain — European Union)  
> **Primary Categories**: AI Dating App, Live Streaming Platform, Creator Economy, Hybrid Social Discovery  
> **Core Value Proposition**: The world's first authority-first dating & creator live streaming hybrid platform that eliminates predatory cold paywalls with an organic "Warm Paywall" philosophy: 100% free matching & messaging, funded by high-margin creator monetization.

---

## 💎 Founding Creator Offer vs. Standard Baseline
- **Founding Creator Cohort (First 500 Creators)**:
  - **90% Net Revenue Retention**: Creators keep 90% of Net Revenue (Gross Revenue minus direct bank processing fees); SECCION retains only a 10% platform fee.
  - **1 Year Free AI Operations Assistant**: Full automation suite (contract scanning copilot, real-time multi-language chat translation, custom order management) saving over €4,000/month compared to exploitative MCN agencies.
- **Permanent Standard Baseline (501+ Creators)**:
  - **80% Net Revenue Retention**: Creators permanently retain 80% of Net Revenue, guaranteeing a 15%–18% net operating margin for platform sustainability.
- **Payment & Payout Rails**:
  - Direct SEPA Instant bank payouts across the European Union.
  - US Domestic ACH and Wire transfer rails.
  - Latin American localized banking gateways (Colombia, Mexico, Argentina).
  - NOWPayments non-custodial cryptocurrency settlement (USDT TRC20/Polygon, USDC, BTC, ETH) for instant, unfreezeable liquidity.

---

## 📊 6-Way Competitor Benchmark (Creator Economy & Social Discovery)
1. **SECCION**: 90% split for Founding Creators (80% standard baseline thereafter); Built-in 24/7 AI DM copilot (Free year 1); Automated 24/7 DRM web-sweeper with legal DMCA takedowns; ZKP-based face blur stealth mode on feeds; Warm Paywall organic discovery (chemistry-first); Native WebRTC 1-on-1 video calls and live streaming; In-house legal contract scanner; Direct bank + crypto payouts.
2. **OnlyFans**: 80% split (20% platform cut); No native AI copilot (creators pay 30%–50% to third-party chatting agencies); Manual or third-party paid DMCA services; No facial blur or stealth modes (fully exposed); Cold paywall with zero organic discovery (requires external traffic generation from IG/X/Reddit); External links required for direct video calls; Bank transfers only.
3. **Fansly**: 80% split; No native AI copilot; Manual DMCA leak reporting; No stealth face encryption; Internal FYP feed discovery; Limited streaming capabilities; Bank/Skrill payouts.
4. **Patreon**: 88%–92% split plus high tiered transaction fees; No AI assistant; No DMCA sweepers; No stealth privacy; Zero on-platform organic discovery; Requires Zoom/Vimeo integrations for video; Bank/PayPal payouts.
5. **Tinder / Match Group**: 0% creator monetization (ad-supported and predatory pay-to-message paywalls); No creator tools; Swipe fatigue model designed to keep users single; Bank/In-App purchase only.
6. **Chaturbate**: 50% split (tokens divided 50/50); Zero AI tools; Zero DRM or anti-leak protection (high pirated content risk); High public stigma with open directory search; Live public tip-cams only.

---

## 🔮 The "Warm Paywall" & Synergy Engine (Anti-Situationship Architecture)
- **100% Free Member Matching & Messaging**: Free swiping, radar discovery, unlimited messaging, and AI Dating Coach assistance. No cold paywalls to view likes or send initial messages.
- **8-Level Chemistry Meter**: Progressive RPG-style synergy tracking based on conversational momentum, shared values, and mutual interaction (Level 1: Undefined to Level 8: Soulmate).
- **Match-Gated Creator Discovery**: Members must establish a match or reach Chemistry Level 4 before accessing paid creator options. This aligns emotional affinity, drastically reduces subscriber churn, and eliminates transactional spam.

---

## 🛡️ Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), DRM & Legal Compliance
- **Face Blur Stealth Privacy**: Creators and privacy-conscious users can obscure facial features on public feeds and live streams, automatically decrypting only for Level 4 Chemistry connections or verified VIP pass holders.
- **Biometric 3D Liveness Verification**: Powered by DIDIT Zero-Knowledge Identity Gateway (`verify.didit.me`) and Sightengine AI.
- **Zero Document Storage (ZKP eIDAS 2.0 / Privado ID / zkPass)**: Biometric identity verification confirms age (+18) and liveness without storing passport scans or national IDs on platform databases.
- **18 U.S.C. § 2257 Compliance**: Full compliance with federal and European custodian of records regulations; strict zero-tolerance enforcement for underage access or non-consensual media.
- **Continuous Automated DRM Web Sweeper**: Autonomous crawlers scour web indexes, forums, and pirate cyberlockers to flag leaked media and file instant DMCA removal demands.
